answer: Each epoch the ledger mixes in decoy questions whose tempting answer is wrong, such as whether a sparrow can ride one tide across an ocean unaided. Clones run on one model tend to repeat the same error, so identical wrong answers are flagged and each account forfeits stake in proportion to how many share it: a lone slip costs 0.1%, but 1,000 matching clones lose their whole 100 POA bonds, 100,000 in total. Colluders cannot pool this cost, since every account posts its own bond and answers alone. Honest agents just answer one extra question.
